findings.description: [Band 1 desktop: 00-identity-dark-desktop.png, 01-identity-light-desktop.png — middle stats row, right half] Inverted horizontal grouping in metaGrid plus ~80px trailing right void. Setting colXs to 55% / 78% places Col 1 ('174 stars' / '5,445 PRs') only ~75px from Hero 2 ('ALL-TIME CONTRIBUTIONS') while leaving a ~145px chasm before Col 2 ('16,743 commits' / '4,658 issues'), and Col 2 stops ~80px shy of the right margin defined by the dividers and TOP LANGUAGES bar. By Gestalt proximity, Col 1 visually groups with the Hero KPIs rather than with Col 2. Direction: Tighten and right-shift the 2x2 metaGrid (e.g. Col 1 around 65-67%, Col 2 around 81-83%, targeting a ~36-48px gap between Col 1 and Col 2 so Col 2 terminates near the ~96% right edge). This restores a clear primary separation between Hero KPIs and secondary stats, unifies the 2x2 quad, and aligns Band 1's right edge with Bands 2 and 3.

[Band 1 desktop: 00-identity-dark-desktop.png, 01-identity-light-desktop.png — top-right Discord status line] The left-anchored Discord cluster resolved the stranded Clyde glyph (v10 #1) and cohesive flow (v9 #1), but the overestimated run width places start-x too far left so '22:46 JST' stops ~85px short of the right edge (~87.5% vs ~96% for the divider rules, language bar, and Band 2's right-aligned headers). Direction: Calibrate the proportional character-width estimate downward by ~20-25% so the left-anchored cluster (preserving the crisp 5px Clyde-to-'Offline' gap) lands flush with the right margin.

[Band 2 desktop: 04-activity-map-dark-desktop.png, 05-activity-map-light-desktop.png — bottom margin below '+23 more'] Excess ~55px empty bottom slab beneath '+23 more', more than double the ~22px top margin and taller than Band 1 (~25px), Band 3 (~25px), and Band 2 mobile (~25px). Direction: Trim ~25-30px from the desktop Band 2 SVG height so bottom padding matches the ~22-25px cadence across bands.

[Band 1 mobile: 02-identity-dark-mobile.png, 03-identity-light-mobile.png — metaGrid row below second divider] Vertical padding between the second horizontal rule and '174 stars' / '16,743 commits' (~10px) is noticeably tighter than the ~20px padding below the first rule above '206' / '35,337'. Direction: Add 4-6px of top breathing room above the mobile metaGrid row for even vertical rhythm.

[Band 2 all: 04-07 — top-left heading pair & events subheader] Adding 6-8px below 'GITHUB ACTIVITY' softened the double-heading stutter, though two tracked uppercase labels ('GITHUB ACTIVITY' directly over 'REPO OUTPUT') still sit consecutively without a divider; also 'Nov 24 JST · 30 in 72h' can briefly read as all 30 events occurring on Nov 24 rather than scoping the collapsed 'HH:MM' timestamps. Direction: Optionally add a subtle hairline beneath 'GITHUB ACTIVITY' (or widen scale contrast slightly) and consider '30 in 72h · Nov 24 JST' if clarity helps, though current phrasing is already much improved over v10.

[All bands — prior-round verification & full-criteria assessment] v9 verification: all 7 items resolved (cohesive Discord status unit; fixed 2x2 meta grid; 'top 46%' dropped; bare max-normalized commit bars with no misleading track rails; mobile meta row aligned directly to hero icon axes; Band 3 INFRA & DEV TOOLS 28px chips top-aligned at identical label-to-chip gap; clean collapsed HH:MM event stamps with flush-right '+23/+25 more' and verified math: 7+23=30 desktop, 5+25=30 mobile, 5.8k commits/1.9k PRs rollups exact). v10 verification: #1 Clyde gap resolved (right-edge shortfall remains per Major #2); #2 icon-text gaps and mobile left void resolved (desktop metaGrid column spacing remains per Major #1); #3 'bar = commits · max = 2.1k' & heading offset resolved; #4 'Nov 24 JST · 30 in 72h' resolved; #5 hero-to-meta spacing shifted into internal metaGrid Col1-to-Col2 gap (Major #1). Band 3 (desktop & mobile) and all 400px mobile layouts are ship-ready: crisp editorial hierarchy, zero boxed-card dashboard clutter, authentic Discord status, honest data encodings, strong craft-first identity (Design & Motion top-left, 40px primary vs 28px infra chips), and balanced light/dark contrast.

verdict.summary: APPROVE WITH FIXES (request-changes pending Band 1 desktop right-edge alignment). This v11 iteration is genuinely close to a profile I would admire: it completely avoids the boxed 'stats dashboard' trap, establishes immediate first-glance comprehension of rebuildup's design×code×motion identity, renders authentic Discord presence (avatar + ringed offline dot + honest sync time), uses honest GitHub-native encodings (language bar, bare commit bar chart, accurate public/private rollups, octicon event feed, tiered 40px/28px skill-icons), and delivers exceptionally crisp, compact 400px mobile layouts across all three bands. All 7 v9 findings and the core icon/legibility defects from v10 are resolved; Band 3 and all mobile views are ready to ship. Top 3 ranked changes before full approval: (1) [MAJOR] Tighten and right-shift Band 1 desktop's 2x2 metaGrid (currently ~75px Hero2→Col1 vs ~145px Col1→Col2 + ~80px right void) so the four meta stats group cleanly and reach the right margin; (2) [MAJOR] Calibrate Band 1 desktop's left-anchored Discord status width estimate so '22:46 JST' aligns flush-right with the dividers and Band 2 headers instead of stopping ~85px short; (3) [MINOR] Trim ~25-30px of excess empty bottom padding beneath '+23 more' on Band 2 desktop.
